events.address: Chelsea Triangle, W 14th St & 9th Ave, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW fragrance-and-coffee activation for NEST New York's Cardamom Latte Eau de Parfum, with a complimentary Cardamom Latte café in Chelsea Triangle.
events.what_is_free: Public walk-in access, complimentary Cardamom Lattes and fragrance sampling are advertised while supplies last.
events.caveats: Current sources agree on a 10 AM start at Chelsea Triangle and describe the activation as public and free. Secondary listings disagree on a fixed closing time (5 PM versus 9 PM), while the giveaway is explicitly while supplies last, so the tracker does not claim an unsupported fixed end time.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 at Chelsea Triangle in the Meatpacking District. Walk-in; arrive earlier if the complimentary latte is the priority because inventory is limited.

events.address: Wolf & Badger, 95 Grand St, New York, NY 10013
events.what_it_is: A three-hour NYFW meet-the-designer and sip-and-shop event for Shine Like Me jewelry at Wolf & Badger SoHo.
events.what_is_free: The event ticket is listed at no charge; browsing, meeting the designer and the event experience are included. Jewelry is retail merchandise.
events.caveats: Eventbrite identifies Wolf & Badger as organizer and confirms September 14, 3–6 PM at 95 Grand Street. A current secondary listing shows the ticket price as 0.00. No organizer-approval language was found.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 from 3–6 PM at Wolf & Badger SoHo. Use the Eventbrite registration page before traveling.

events.address: Top of the Strand Rooftop Bar, 33 W 37th St, New York, NY 10018
events.what_it_is: A limited-capacity rooftop pop-up for Korean skincare brand cepoLAB with skincare experiences, small bites, a signature cocktail and creator networking.
events.what_is_free: The hosted experience includes skincare activities, refreshments and an advertised free gift for attendees.
events.caveats: The live Partiful page shows limited capacity and says RSVP is required to guarantee entry, while also directing guests to an official RSVP page. No approval/host-selection language was established, so this is categorized as Free RSVP rather than Approval Required. The event is framed toward NYC creators, UGC creators and micro-influencers.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 1–4 PM at Top of the Strand Rooftop Bar. Complete the RSVP before traveling because capacity is limited.
